description: This is a Java service class for managing authors within a book project application. It provides methods for CRUD operations and interacts with the AuthorRepository to perform data access.

classes.name: AuthorService
classes.description: Service class that provides methods to manage Author entities, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and counting authors.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an Author by its ID, returning an Optional<Author>.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all authors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a new or updated Author entity.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Author entities.
